packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time email review route renders as a compact black/yellow review-only email template surface on desktop and mobile, with no send, payment, access grant, account, DNS, Resend, or external-provider behavior change.

title: Email Review Brand And Layout Cleanup

reasons: Latest email-review screenshots show the route with an oversized logo masthead that consumes the first viewport before the review work surface.
The template cards still read as a pale generic review grid rather than a One Time black/yellow provider email review surface.

The fix can be scoped to visual layout and copy structure in the static review page without changing the email template endpoint, no-send policy, route access, registry, or external provider behavior.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Resend sender/domain setup, recipient policy, DNS, real email sends, payment, checkout, and access grants remain out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this email-review cleanup, continue screenshot-reviewed IA/nav/filter cleanup or CRM contact-detail polish.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time email review page feel even, readable, and correctly branded by replacing the oversized masthead and pale generic cards with a compact One Time black/yellow preview-only email review surface.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No email template data contract, endpoint path, fetch behavior, send-readiness values, route registry, auth, entitlement, payment, checkout, account, access grant, recipient policy, DNS, Resend, or external-provider behavior change.
No live email send, bulk email, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Stripe/payment, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account mutation, upload, publish, or external CRM write.
No GHL runtime or LeadConnector reference.
No raw private parent, student, member, provider, contact, email body beyond the existing synthetic review templates, token, secret, or credential evidence.

inspection_targets: public/one-time-email-review.html inline page styles, header markup, template card renderer, and no-send labels
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: Desktop first viewport is dominated by an oversized One Time logo masthead instead of a compact review work surface.
Template cards render as generic pale cards with weak visual grouping for subject, preview text, recipient scope, no-send status, and blocked reason.
Mobile page stacks 21 templates in a very long pale column without enough dark One Time framing or scannable template metadata.

expanded_phrases.clean: The email review route should read as a polished One Time no-send review console, not a leftover generic card dump.
expanded_phrases.even: Header, warning, template cards, chips, body previews, and blocked reasons should share consistent One Time black/yellow spacing, typography, and card structure.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first loaded desktop and mobile screenshots should show a compact header, visible no-send warning, and contained template cards with no horizontal overflow or layout jump.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: This remains a first-party BNA Operations / One Time review-only email surface scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class, with no external email provider writes.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time email review route so it uses a compact One Time black/yellow review-only layout with readable template cards and a clear no-send setup state.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a compact branded header, visible blocked-send notice, dark/readable template cards, consistent chips, contained body-preview text, and no horizontal overflow, while the email review endpoint and no-send behavior remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The email review route no longer renders an oversized logo masthead that pushes the template review surface below the fold.
Template cards use dark One Time panels with readable headings, subject/preview/body blocks, recipient scope, preview-only status, no-send status, and blocked-reason copy.
The no-send/blocked-provider setup state remains visible before the template grid and cannot be mistaken for a live send surface.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow, clipped card text, or unreadable low-contrast template metadata.
The existing /api/one-time-review/email-templates fetch, review-only template count, route access, no-send values, and external-write policy remain unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Brand memory and design reference confirm One Time is black/yellow.
Latest desktop and mobile screenshots show the email review route with an oversized masthead and generic pale template cards.
The route registry already states the email review page is public-entry, review-only, and performs no sends or external writes.
The likely fix is scoped to one static page's markup/CSS only, with no email endpoint or provider setup mutation.
